entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I ordered a jersey a few weeks ago and... well, it just doesn't fit. I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?
It's the size. It's the wrong size for me. It's just... it's really too tight. I feel so disappointed. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I was really looking forward to this.
I understand that can be frustrating. So to confirm, the jersey is too tight and you'd like to proceed with a return. Are you hoping to do an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer a refund?
I think just a refund, if that's okay. The event I bought it for has already passed. Honestly, I could really use that money back right now. It would help a lot.
Of course. Let me just pull up your order and check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the jersey was delivered 27 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely approve this for you.
Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried it would be a problem.

Not a problem at all. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
